```yaml
verdict: accept-with-findings
findings:
  - severity: major
    lens: silent-failure-hunting
    file: scripts/hapax-glmcp-reviewer
    line: 845
    title: ZaiHttpError escapes reservation failure reconciliation
    detail: >
      In call_glm, if the PAYG endpoint raises a ZaiHttpError (e.g., re-raised at line 814), it is not caught by `except ApiError as fallback_exc:` at line 845 because ZaiHttpError does not appear to inherit from ApiError (as evidenced by line 783 wrapping it). Consequently, the exception will bubble up and bypass `_mark_payg_spend_receipt_failed`, leaving a dangling reservation in the ledger. Furthermore, the `isinstance(fallback_exc, ZaiHttpError)` check at line 849 is unreachable. The block should likely catch `(ApiError, ZaiHttpError)`.

```yaml
verdict: accept-with-findings
findings:
  - severity: major
    lens: silent-failure-hunting
    file: scripts/hapax-glmcp-reviewer
    line: 845
    title: ZaiHttpError escapes reservation failure reconciliation
    detail: >
      In call_glm, if the PAYG endpoint raises a ZaiHttpError (e.g., re-raised at line 814), it is not caught by `except ApiError as fallback_exc:` at line 845 because ZaiHttpError does not appear to inherit from ApiError (as evidenced by line 783 wrapping it). Consequently, the exception will bubble up and bypass `_mark_payg_spend_receipt_failed`, leaving a dangling reservation in the ledger. Furthermore, the `isinstance(fallback_exc, ZaiHttpError)` check at line 849 is unreachable. The block should likely catch `(ApiError, ZaiHttpError)`.
